description.value: On a <select>: switches the accent variant on change.
Click moves to the next accent variant.
On the no-flash.js <script>: URL template for lazy skins, with {skin} standing for the name.
On the bundle <script>: do not boot automatically; call bk.start() yourself.
Click opens the modal or drawer this selector points at.
Click opens or closes the modal or drawer this selector points at.
Click closes the overlay this selector points at, or the enclosing dialog when empty or "true".
Treat this element as a modal even though it is not a dialog.bk-modal.
On a modal: "non-modal" opens it without a backdrop or inert page.
On a modal or drawer: "false" stops a backdrop click from closing it.
On a modal or drawer: "true" ignores Esc and shakes instead of closing.
On a modal or drawer: selector of the element that receives focus on open.
Command palette dialog. The value is its hotkey, "mod+k" by default.
On a command palette item: extra words it matches when searching.
On a menu, command palette or combobox item: the value reported when it is chosen.
On a menu or command palette item: "true" keeps the panel open after choosing it.
Tooltip text, shown on hover and keyboard focus.
CSS-only tooltip text, shown on hover without the runtime.
Click toggles the popover panel this selector points at.
Click toggles the dropdown menu this selector points at, with arrow-key navigation.
Where a tooltip, popover or menu opens. It flips when there is no room.
On a tooltip: milliseconds before it shows. Default 120.
Accessible tabs with arrow-key navigation on this container.
On tabs: "manual" moves focus with the arrows and activates on Enter or Space.
On tabs: storage key that remembers the chosen tab across visits.
On a tab: selector of the panel it shows.
Accordion on this container. "single" keeps only one section open.
Click expands or collapses the panel this selector points at.
Click toggles a class on the element this selector points at.
With data-bk-toggle: the class to toggle. Default bk-is-open.
On a nav: marks the link whose section is in view. The value can scope the sections.
On scrollspy or smooth scrolling: pixels to leave for a sticky header.
On a navbar: adds a scrolled state after this many pixels. Default 8.
With data-bk-navbar-scroll: hide the navbar while scrolling down.
Back-to-top button that appears after this many pixels. Default 400.
Smooth scrolling for in-page links inside this element.
On a <table>: sortable columns, plus filtering with data-bk-filter.
On a <th>: makes the column sortable, compared as this type.
On a cell: the value to sort by instead of its text.
On a table: selector of the search input that filters its rows.
On a table: selector of the element that shows how many rows match.
Carousel with scroll snapping, dots and previous and next buttons.
On a carousel: milliseconds between slides. 0 or absent means no autoplay.
On a carousel: "false" stops at the last slide.
Counts up to this number when scrolled into view.
On a counter: animation length in milliseconds. Default 1400.
On a counter: decimal places to show.
On a counter: text before the number.
On a counter: text after the number.
Progress bar or ring value from 0 to 100.
Click copies the text of the element this selector points at, or the value itself.
On a copy button: confirmation text. Default "Copied".
On a copy button: briefly swap its label for the confirmation.
On a copy button: confirm with a toast.
Keyboard shortcut that clicks this element, such as "mod+k" or "shift+/".
Fades the element in when it scrolls into view.
On a reveal: "false" hides it again when it leaves the view.
On a reveal: delay in milliseconds.
Material-style ripple on press.
Scrolling marquee. The value, if a number, is the loop length in seconds.
Toast declared in markup. The value is how long it stays, in milliseconds. Default 4000.
On a toast: where it stacks.
On a <form>: inline validation messages instead of the browser bubbles.
On a field: the one message shown for any validation failure.
On a field: message shown for valueMissing.
On a field: message shown for typeMismatch.
On a field: message shown for patternMismatch.
On a field: message shown for tooShort.
On a field: message shown for tooLong.
On a field: message shown for rangeUnderflow.
On a field: message shown for rangeOverflow.
On a field: message shown for stepMismatch.
On a field: message shown for badInput.
On a <textarea>: grows with its content.
On an input, textarea or select: selector of the element that shows its character count.
On a .bk-range input: selector of the element that shows its value.
Click shows or hides the password field this selector points at.
One-time code input with this many boxes. Default 6.
Tag input: type and press Enter or the separator to add a tag.
On a tag input: the character that ends a tag. Default ",".
On a tag input: the most tags allowed. 0 means no limit.
File drop area. The value can point at its file input.
On a dropzone: selector of the element that lists the chosen files.
Searchable combobox with keyboard navigation.
On a combobox: its options as a JSON array, or a comma-separated list.
Number stepper with increment and decrement buttons.
Inside a stepper: "1" for the increment button, "-1" for the decrement button.
Inside a stepper: the increment button.
Inside a stepper: the decrement button.
Checkbox that checks every data-bk-check-item. The value can scope them.
Checkbox controlled by a data-bk-check-all.
